published_value: Gutenberg / arXiv / Wikipedia (en + de,fr,es,ja,zh,ru) / CPython v3.12.8 Lib; calibration-overlapping documents are pre-excluded.
defect: the field was hard-coded prose carried forward from the v3 builder and does not describe the v5 corpus: the v5 code stratum is pinned to python/cpython@v3.13.1 and numpy/numpy@v2.2.1, and the multilingual stratum covers 21 languages, not six.

authoritative_source.note: every corpus document appears there with its source URL, byte count and sha256; the suite manifest's own `documents` array carries the same per-document digests, so the corpus is fully identified without the prose field.

measured_scope: documentation only: no token, digest, exclusion count, context, or fidelity number in the manifest is affected, and no measurement was rerun.

code_fix.change: the builder no longer emits hard-coded corpus provenance; it points at the per-document digests and the fetch log instead.
code_fix.applies_to: suites built after this commit; the published v5 manifest is left byte-identical.
